title: 第5章 很高兴认识你第6章 美好的未来
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
苏醒侧身让开通道，准备离开这个让他命运转折的地方。
那个穿着笔挺西装的中年人却忽然开口，声音温和却带着一种难以言喻的穿透力：
“小兄弟，看样子，你觉醒成功了？恭喜啊。
是什么职业和天赋啊？”
这声音似乎有种奇异的魔力，钻入苏醒的耳中，让他刚经历进阶、尚且敏感的精神微微一荡，生出一种莫名的信任感与倾诉欲。
他几乎是下意识地脱口而出：“白银单手剑士，天赋是……”
“够了！”
一声如同惊雷般的怒喝猛地炸响，瞬间将苏醒从那种恍惚状态中惊醒！
他猛地闭上嘴，心脏怦怦直跳，额角渗出冷汗，又惊又怒
——自己刚才怎么了？怎么会几乎将最重要的底牌和盘托出？
发出怒喝的，正是引领苏醒进来的那位神教修士。
他一步跨出，挡在苏醒身前，面色铁青地直视着那西装中年人，厉声斥责道：
“马克奇先生！
不要太过分了！
在大地之母的神殿内，胆敢公然对刚完成仪式的觉醒者使用职业能力？你这是对神殿的亵渎与蔑视！”
被叫做马克奇的中年男人脸上不见丝毫慌乱，只是慢条斯理地整理了一下自己的西装领带，语气漫不经心：
“赵修士言重了。
我只是见这位少年才俊觉醒成功，心中欢喜，随口问了句恭喜的话而已。
这…算不上什么大事吧？”
他刻意忽略了“职业能力”

这个关键词。
“随口问问？”
赵修士气得冷笑一声，
“商人职业的三阶能力——‘蛊惑人心’，能无形中降低他人心防，诱导说出真实信息！
你敢说你刚才没有动用这个能力？！”
“证据呢？”
马克奇双手一摊，脸上露出标准的、无辜的商业笑容。
“赵修士，指控一位体面的商人，可是需要证据的。
您有证据证明我使用了能力吗？”
赵修士立刻将目光投向旁边那位端着银质托盘的同僚，希望他能出声作证。
然而，那位修士却明显偏开了视线，低头假装研究托盘里高级药水的光泽，对同事的求助目光视若无睹。
——开什么玩笑！
这托盘里的三瓶药水价值五千金，自己的提成接近百金。
眼前这位马克奇先生可是难得的大主顾，怎么可能为了一个刚觉醒的穷小子和一点“小事”
content_en:
Su Xing turned sideways to get out of the way, preparing to leave this place where his fate changed.
The middle-aged man in a crisp suit suddenly spoke, his voice gentle but with an indescribable penetrating power:
"Little brother, it seems that you have successfully awakened? Congratulations.
What is your profession and talent? "
This voice seemed to have a strange magic power. It penetrated into the awakened ears, causing his newly advanced and sensitive spirit to waver slightly, giving rise to an inexplicable sense of trust and desire to talk.
He blurted out almost subconsciously: "The silver one-handed swordsman's talent is..."
"Enough!"
A roar like thunder exploded, instantly waking Su Xing up from his trance!
He shut his mouth suddenly, his heart was pounding, cold sweat broke out on his forehead, he was shocked and angry.
——What happened to you just now? How could the most important trump card be revealed almost completely?
The one who shouted angrily was the cult monk who led Su Xing in.
He stepped forward and stood in front of Su Xing. He looked directly at the middle-aged man in a suit with a livid face and scolded sternly:
"Mr. Markchi!
Don't go too far!
In the temple of Mother Earth, do you dare to openly use professional abilities on the awakened ones who have just completed the ritual? You are blaspheming and scorning the temple! "
The middle-aged man named Markchi showed no trace of panic on his face. He just adjusted his suit and tie slowly and said in a nonchalant tone:
"Brother Zhao is serious.
I was just happy to see this young talent successfully awakening, and casually asked congratulations.
This... isn't a big deal, is it? "
He deliberately ignored "professional ability"
this keyword.
"Just asking?"
Brother Zhao sneered angrily,
"The third-level ability of the businessman profession - 'Confuse people's hearts', can invisibly lower the defenses of others and induce them to tell the true information!
Do you dare to say that you didn't use this ability just now? ! "
"Where's the evidence?"
Marki spread his hands and showed a standard, innocent business smile on his face.
"Brother Zhao, you need evidence to accuse a decent businessman.
Do you have proof that I used my powers? "
Brother Zhao immediately turned his attention to the colleague holding the silver tray next to him, hoping that he would speak out to testify.
However, the monk obviously averted his gaze, lowered his head and pretended to study the luster of the high-grade potion in the tray, turning a blind eye to his colleague's look for help.
——What a joke!
The three bottles of potions in this tray are worth five thousand gold, and my commission is close to one hundred gold.
The Mr. Markchi in front of him is a rare big customer. How could he do this for a newly awakened poor boy and a "little thing"?
